A stone of mass 0.12kg is fired from a catapult. The velocity of the stone changes from 0 to
5.0m/s in 0.60s.
What is the average resultant force acting on the stone while it is being fired?
A
1.0N
B
2.5N
C
3.6N
D
8.3N
